iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

POLICY
       Namespace POLICY

DESCRIPTION
       iRules command namespace which allows inspection and modification of centralized policy matching (CPM) policies.  CPM
       replaces the HTTP class profile and HTTP_CLASS_SELECTED HTTP_CLASS_FAILED events in v11.4

       Associated Events
	  HTTP_REQUEST HTTP_RESPONSE

       Related Information
	  See the  HTTP_CLASS_FAILED events which CPM replaces in v11.4

HINTS
SEE ALSO
BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
